channel.title: Blockchain Today
channel.description: Blockchain Today reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and network upgrades, with analysis of what changed.

item.title: Three Checks Before Canceling a Partly Filled CoW Swap Order
item.description: A partial fill leaves only part of a CoW Swap order open. Check what settled, whether cancellation has cleared, and what each cancellation route can cost.

item.title: How a tron swap moves TRC-20 tokens—and what it costs
item.description: A TRON swap moves value through token contracts and liquidity pools; approval, Energy costs, routing and slippage determine what arrives and what the trade really costs.

item.title: TRON Energy: What a Contract Call Actually Costs
item.description: TRON Energy pays for smart contract execution, but the amount depends on the call, available resources and any developer subsidy; estimate each transaction before sending.

item.title: Mastercard opens AI agent payment tools to developers
item.description: Mastercard has opened Agent Pay for Machines to developers after pilots, pairing x402 payment requests with spending limits and settlement through crypto and fiat rails.

item.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first retail Bitcoin ETF
item.description: FINMA approved Switzerland’s first retail fund investing directly in Bitcoin, adding a regulated fund route while leaving investors exposed to sharp price swings.

item.title: Mesh and Visa link wallet balances to Visa spending
item.description: Mesh and Visa will let participating wallets route crypto and stablecoin balances into Visa purchases, removing a separate card while leaving rollout details unsettled.

item.title: Why a Cross-Chain Transfer Has More Than One Transaction Hash
item.description: A cross-chain transfer spans separate ledgers, so its source and destination actions get separate hashes; tracking both shows where the value is still moving.

item.title: Ledger Says Criminal Group Implanted CryptoBilis Wallets
item.description: Ledger says criminals altered genuine CryptoBilis wallets to capture recovery phrases, while blockchain researchers put theft estimates above $90 million.

item.title: Pump.fun adds Hyperliquid perps, extending beyond memecoins
item.description: Pump.fun has added Hyperliquid-routed perps to its app, widening its trading offer while leaving execution, collateral and liquidation with Hyperliquid.

item.title: Five Checks Before Stablecoins Enter a Business App
item.description: Stablecoins can settle beyond banking hours, but an app needs explicit choices for network, confirmation, custody, reconciliation and conversion before launch.

item.title: Babylon proposes native Bitcoin collateral for Aave V4
item.description: Babylon has asked Aave governance to add native Bitcoin collateral to V4, offering BTC holders stablecoin borrowing while adding new settlement and risk layers.

item.title: Moving DeFi Collateral Starts With the Debt
item.description: Repay or refinance the debt before withdrawing collateral, then check the destination chain, liquidity and transaction order to avoid leaving a loan exposed.

item.title: A First Cross-Chain Swap: Pool Depth Versus Withdrawal
item.description: A first THORChain swap uses two RUNE-linked pools, while a withdrawal returns an LP share; pool depth, slippage and chain fees shape the practical choice.

item.title: Four checks for unused assets after a partial crypto swap
item.description: A partial fill can leave source tokens waiting or due for refund; check the swap status, asset, transaction records and fees before acting on the remainder.

item.title: Depositing Monero to an ERC-20 Exchange Takes Two Steps
item.description: Monero cannot be sent to an ERC-20 address; the route depends on whether an exchange accepts native XMR or requires a separate conversion before Ethereum withdrawal.

item.title: Why bridges deduct gas from the tokens you receive
item.description: Bridges may use a relayer to complete the destination transaction, then recover its cost from your tokens; the deduction can also include other route fees.

item.title: Why Destination-Chain Gas Can Reduce Your Crypto Transfer
item.description: Destination-chain gas can be prepaid from the transfer or left for the wallet to cover; read the quote to see which applies and how much arrives spendable.

item.title: Why Cross-Chain Swap Minimums Need a Treasury Policy
item.description: Cross-chain swap minimums are route limits, not treasury policy: teams should quote each pair, price fixed costs and slippage, then set an internal floor.

item.title: ASIC sets draft rules for Australian crypto platforms
item.description: ASIC has opened consultation on draft licensing, custody and trading standards for crypto platforms, setting terms ahead of Australia's 2027 licensing regime.

item.title: Move Tokens Before a Sequencer Outage: Plan the Exit
item.description: Move tokens before a sequencer outage by checking the chain’s exit path, funding gas and weighing direct withdrawals against faster bridge routes and their limits.
